audit_limitations: This audit relies solely on the provided synthetic JSON observations and arithmetic seeds. No external clinical context, user diary, or device firmware logs are available. The PROVISIONAL_LLM_GOLD labels and knowledge applicability notes are treated as fallible metadata, not ground truth. Correlation shifts observed in the paired statistics may reflect mathematical artifacts of range restriction rather than physiological changes, and this audit cannot definitively distinguish between them. Representations suggesting device malfunction or wear changes are flagged as unsupported interpretations because the raw data lacks diagnostic sensor metadata. All findings are provisional LLM analysis and cannot establish clinical truth or a final research conclusion.
